title: World tree myth of survivors climbing into the heavens

tellings.quote: Some of the stories like for example the the world tree where the great catastrophe comes and human humanity climbs the world tree

plain: Randall Carlson, a researcher, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that stories told around the world include one about a world tree: after a great catastrophe and flood, humanity climbs the tree into the heavens. He tells it as a possible memory, kept in myth, of people surviving a real ancient disaster.
